name: Support Zone Bounce
market_conditions: price approaching a well-established support zone
support zone has been tested and held at least twice previously
broader trend is neutral to bullish or price is in a range
no major bearish catalyst or news event imminent
support zone is not in a steeply declining trend where it is likely to break
phase_requirements: retracement phase approaching support in an uptrend
lower boundary of a range in accumulation phase
not during aggressive markdown phase where support is likely to fail
entry_conditions: price reaches or tags the support zone boundary
rejection candle forms at the support zone: hammer, pin bar, bullish engulfing, or dragonfly doji
lower wick of rejection candle penetrates into the zone but candle closes above it
volume on rejection candle is above the 10-period average
RSI is at or approaching oversold region (30-45 range) on the entry timeframe
confirmation_requirements: rejection candle closes above the support zone midpoint
follow-through candle in the bullish direction confirms the bounce
volume on follow-through candle is above average
RSI turning upward from the 30-45 zone
price does not close below the support zone on any subsequent candle before entry
MACD histogram shows reducing bearish momentum or bullish cross near the zone
stop_loss_logic: Place stop loss below the lowest wick that tagged the support zone, plus a 0.5-1 ATR buffer below the zone's lower boundary. The stop must be below a level that would definitively invalidate the support zone.
take_profit_logic: First target at the most recent swing high or resistance level above. Second target at the upper boundary of the range or prior structural high. Take partial profit at 1:1 RR and trail the rest with a 20 EMA on the entry timeframe.
invalidation_conditions: price closes below the support zone lower boundary with a full bearish candle body
high volume bearish candle breaks through the zone indicating institutional selling
multiple consecutive candles close inside or below the zone without bouncing
RSI breaks below 25 indicating panic selling rather than a bounce setup
a gap down through the support zone on the open
broader market index breaks a key support level simultaneously

required_features.support_zone_quality: tested at least twice, clear zone boundaries
required_features.rejection_candle: present at zone with long lower wick
required_features.zone_proximity: price within zone boundaries or tagging lower boundary

timeframe_requirements.macro: 1D or 4H to identify and qualify the support zone
timeframe_requirements.entry: 1H or 15M to spot the rejection candle and time the entry

risk_notes: Support zones weaken each time they are tested. A third or fourth test of a support zone is less reliable than the first or second. Always check if the broader trend is against you. A support bounce trade in a strong downtrend carries higher risk of a false bounce. Ensure the support zone is drawn from significant swing lows, not arbitrary levels. Do not risk more than 1.5% on any single support bounce trade.

agent_rules.rule: Only trade support zones that have been validated by at least two prior touches.
Require a reversal candle with a prominent lower wick at the zone — a plain bearish close is not sufficient.
If price closes a full candle body below the support zone, exit the trade immediately — do not wait for a bounce.
Check the macro timeframe (1D) before entering — if the daily trend is strongly bearish, require additional confluences.
Move stop to breakeven after price travels 1 ATR from entry in the intended direction.
